title.narrative: Anti-war media project: raising awareness about Russia's crimes in Ukraine and combating fake Russian military propaganda and hate speech

description.narrative:
The project aims to contribute to raising awareness about Russia's disinformation narratives and war crimes in Ukraine among English, French, Spanish, and russian-speaking audiences through various communication channels. The specific objectives are to provide russian-speaking audiences with access to information regarding the criminal actions of the putin regime and their consequences, the war crimes of the russian army in Ukraine, and the harm the war causes to the economies. Additionally, English, French, and Spanish-speaking audiences will gain access to important information for controlling narratives around the war in the face of russian disinformation campaigns and the latest updates about the situation in Ukraine.

1.    Increase global awareness of russia's crimes in Ukraine by creating video content on YouTube and TikTok, managing communication channels for English, French, Spanish, and russian-speaking audiences,

2.    Counter russian disinformation campaigns and fostering informed public discourse by promoting anti-war sentiment in russia and belarus in Twitter, Tik Tok, and Telegram for russian-speaking audiences;

3.    Reinforcing and promoting the work of the channels by approaching French and Spanish speaking influencers in Africa and Latin America.

By achieving these goals, the project will contribute to anti-war sentiment in russia, belarus, Africa and Latin America and contribute to raising the world's awareness about russia¿s crimes in Ukraine.
